why_this_packet_exists: F793 freezes the larger normalization-boundary target and includes top_boundary_anchor_rule_ref as a missing component.
P794 shows that bounded-grid admissibility is no longer the sharp blocker; the sharper blocker is the missing semantic anchor for the boundary point 1.

target_object.goal: Freeze the exact top-boundary anchor object still missing before the current max-normalized family can move closer to export-grade authority.

required_fields.name: candidate_family_domain_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must point to one explicit finite alpha_s family domain; silent domain drift is forbidden.

required_fields.name: top_boundary_point_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must identify the explicit boundary point 1 inside the admitted normalized family schema.

required_fields.name: boundary_point_semantic_role_rule_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must export the strict-side rule assigning role to the boundary point 1 without introducing host units, GeV, or Standard Model identification.

required_fields.name: strict_input_chain_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must reuse only strict-side exported inputs and remain independent of external calibration policy objects.

required_fields.name: nonstrict_calibration_exclusion_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must explicitly fence off the proxy-to-GeV calibration lane from supplying the anchor meaning.

required_fields.name: selected_anchor_output_schema
required_fields.hard_limit: Must output the admitted boundary point and its role inside the selected normalized family schema.

required_fields.name: hard_limits
required_fields.hard_limit: Must explicitly deny Standard Model identification, QCD closure, and ToE closure.

current_honest_reading: The current sharp blocker is no longer whether max-normalization yields a bounded grid.
It is the missing strict-side rule that would give semantic role to the explicit top boundary point 1.
F794 freezes that exact missing object without promoting the current family winner.
recommended_next_move: Build one narrow probe testing whether any current strict-side export can justify semantic anchoring of the boundary point 1 without borrowing anything from the nonstrict calibration lane.
hard_limits: Does not claim that the top-boundary anchor rule already exists.
Does not claim that f704_max_mode_anchor_family is already promoted.
Does not claim alpha_s boundary export readiness.
